mapper.select: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sys12_yyyymm) AS gen_ledger_id , f_get_last_day(CAST(sys12_yyyymm||'01' AS DATE)) AS std_date , f_cdnm('MonthsCode', substr(sys12_yyyymm,5,2), #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS month_name , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act04_close_count,0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE '마감완료' END AS close_name FROM ( SELECT to_char(sys12_day,'yyyymm') as sys12_yyyymm FROM sys12_calendar WHERE sys12_company_id = #{companyId} AND to_char(sys12_day,'yyyy') = #{year} GROUP BY to_char(sys12_day,'yyyymm') ) a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT to_char(act05_std_date,'yyyymm') AS act04_yyyymm , count(*) AS act04_close_count FROM act05_gen_ledger_close WHERE act05_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY to_char(act05_std_date,'yyyymm') ) b ON act04_yyyymm = sys12_yyyymm

SELECT COALESCE(act15_close_check_id, row_number() over()) AS close_check_id , sys01_company_id AS company_id , sys01_company_nm AS company_name , COALESCE(act15_deposit_real_match_yn , 'true') AS deposit_real_match_yn , COALESCE(act15_deposit_appr_yn , 'true') AS deposit_appr_yn , COALESCE(act15_deposit_ledger_match_yn , 'true') AS deposit_ledger_match_yn , COALESCE(act15_finance_eval_yn , 'true') AS finance_eval_yn , COALESCE(act15_finance_ledger_match_yn , 'true') AS finance_ledger_match_yn , COALESCE(act15_fx_eval_yn , 'true') AS fx_eval_yn , COALESCE(act15_depn_yn , 'true') AS depn_yn , COALESCE(act15_tangible_match_yn , 'true') AS tangible_match_yn , COALESCE(act15_intangible_match_yn , 'true') AS intangible_match_yn , COALESCE(act15_fund_fee_match_yn , 'true') AS fund_fee_match_yn , COALESCE(act15_fund_fee_eval_yn , 'true') AS fund_fee_eval_yn , COALESCE(act15_unfix_yn , 'true') AS unfix_yn , COALESCE(act15_supply_match_yn , 'true') AS supply_match_yn FROM sys01_company LEFT OUTER JOIN act15_close_check ON act15_company_id = sys01_company_id WHERE COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys01_company_id != 0 AND sys01_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sys01_company_id

mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE act_list ( act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , act01_level ) AS ( SELECT act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , 0 FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND act01_account_cd = #{accountCode} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a.act01_account_cd , a.act01_parent_cd , b.act01_level + 1 FROM act01_account_code a , act_list b WHERE a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.act01_account_cd = b.act01_parent_cd AND COALESCE(a.act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) SELECT t.act01_account_cd FROM act_list INNER JOIN act01_account_code t ON ( t.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND t.act01_account_cd = act_list.act01_account_cd ) ORDER BY act_list.act01_level ASC
